findings.detail: B01 appears to count both amortized-cost and fair-value source facts as leaves; the raw schedule provides fair value alongside amortized cost for the 2025 investment rows and totals.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate/completeness review. The 2025 schedule has explicit Amortized Cost and Fair Value columns, and its current-period subtotals roll to the same schedule total: debt fair value 201,253,329 plus equity fair value 7,261,709 plus cash equivalents fair value 4,426,311 equals Total Investments fair value 212,941,349. Representative individual rows and totals show fair value is present in source; the 91/182 B01 metric is therefore consistent with counting amortized-cost facts in the denominator, not with missing fair values in the filing source.
